scope: Exploratory secondary analysis of frozen PWA-PushT-v1.4 artifacts; this is not part of the original preregistration and does not alter any frozen artifact.

confidence_definition.candidate_deduplication: Collapse candidates by physical_action_sha256 and retain the minimum predicted_score per distinct physical action.
confidence_definition.raw_margin: second-smallest minus smallest predicted score across distinct physical actions
confidence_definition.historical_error_scale: Within each model, median absolute candidate-level encoded_real_score minus predicted_score, estimated after excluding the held-out trajectory_id.
confidence_definition.primary_confidence: raw_margin divided by historical_error_scale; larger is more confident
confidence_definition.fallback: If the training median absolute error is non-positive, use the training root-mean-square error; if still non-positive, abstain.

primary_target.name: P_O_selection_stability
primary_target.primary_metric: AUROC of primary_confidence for selection stability
primary_target.fixed_policy: For each held-out trajectory, retain rows at or above the median primary_confidence of all same-model training trajectories.
primary_target.policy_metric: cross-fitted retained-minus-all switch-risk difference with a 10000 trajectory-cluster bootstrap interval

comparators: always act / random abstention at matched coverage
row-relative margin divided by the predicted-score 90th-minus-10th percentile spread
maximum softmax probability and entropy of negative predicted scores, with temperature equal to the held-out historical error scale

reporting_gates.actionable_decision_confidence: Claim only if the primary AUROC 95% interval is entirely above 0.5, the cross-fitted retained-minus-all switch-risk interval is entirely below zero, and the original-only sensitivity has the same directions.
reporting_gates.physical_risk: Claim only if both G- and J-reversal AUROCs exceed 0.5, at least one trajectory-bootstrap interval is entirely above 0.5, and the corresponding fixed-policy risk changes have the expected direction.
reporting_gates.otherwise: Report a null or descriptive result; do not call the score uncertainty quantification.
